games.name: SoulShatters Test Place
games.desc:
Teleporting to a different server = New Update. Shutdown = Emergency Fix.

In this game, it's kill or be killed. This is a fighting game, "randoming" doesn't exist.

Welcome to SoulShatters! There are many planned changes and features that aren't, won't, may, and will be in the final release.

Current Characters Include: Sans, Glitchtale Chara, Storyshift Chara, Undyne, Bete Noire, Asriel Dreemurr, Frisk, XTale Sans/Chara, Delta Sans, Glitchtale Frisk, Sakuya Izayoi, Stevonnie, and Carrot God!

Controls:

[LMB/RMB]: Melee Combat 
[F]: Block 
[R]: Teleport/Transportation 
[Left Control]: Run 
[Double Tapping any Movement Key]: Dash (Instantly makes you run) 
[MMB/L]: Lock/unlock your cursor. (Required for certain moves) 
[1-9]: Special Attacks (Will require Mana) 
[Q/E]: Change modes for certain characters. 

Keep up to date with changes, updates, and planned features.

games.name: Adventure Story!
games.desc:
A multiplayer, turn-based action-adventure game set in a cartoony world full of interesting and charming characters. You travel the world to learn powerful abilities in order to conquer the most evil beings with the help of your friends, while collecting treasures and valuable relics along the way.

--------------------------------------------------------

2026 changes:
- Fixed lots of issues, optimized some things, slight battle improvements
- Reset dungeon ratings and fixed generation issues with it
- Increased card drop rates from 1 in 8 to 1 in 2
- Increased corrupted enemy rates when at max level
- Fixed fleeing, made some battle camera movements faster
- Dungeon difficulty is now total of player ratings instead of combined average
- Dungeon rating on victory is no longer split between each player
- Endless dungeons now scale faster based on number of players

games.name: [EASTER🐰] Obby King Remastered
games.desc:
Obby King is a fast-paced obstacle course game built for players who enjoy competitive challenges and exciting gameplay. Race through 100+ unique obbies, beat the clock, and compete against other players in a single continuous tournament experience.

There are rounds. Whether you’re new to Obby King or an experienced obby player, the game is easy to pick up and challenging to master.

Stay focused. Move fast. Claim the crown.

Features
- Round-style gameplay - compete from start to finish
- Time-based challenges - speed and accuracy matter
- Progress-based competition - keep up to stay in the action
- 100+ obby maps with increasing difficulty
- Earn coins and customise your character
- Leaderboards - track progress and show your skills

Invite your friends, enter the tournament, and see who rises to the top.
